about: Renders nested rows that open and close, walked by the keyboard as one control. A branch row opens the rows under it and an item row ends a path. The tree reads a collection, and a render function renders each node's row from the node and its state.

docs.about: An item with an `href` renders a link, which follows its address on a press and on Enter. `TreeView.BranchIndentGuide`, passed to `TreeView.Nodes` as `indentGuide`, runs a line down every open branch under its indicator.
docs.label: Documentation
docs.title: Links

effect.about: The glow surrounds a selected row in the palette's solid color.
effect.title: Effects

lazy.about: A branch that declares `childrenCount` loads its children through `loadChildren` the first time it opens. The row reports `aria-busy` while it loads, and the example turns its indicator into a spinner. The caller keeps the collection that `onLoadChildrenComplete` returns.
lazy.label: Offices
lazy.title: Loading children

outline.about: With `expandOnClick={false}` a press on a row selects it, and a press on `TreeView.BranchTrigger` opens it. The caller controls `expandedValue`, so two buttons open and close every branch. A node with `disabled` takes no selection and opens no rows.
outline.label: Report outline
outline.title: Outline

palette.about: The palette sets the selected fill, the focus ring and the checkboxes.
palette.title: Palettes

permissions.about: With `checkable`, every row reports `aria-checked` and Space toggles the check. A branch is checked while every node under it is, and partly checked while some are. `TreeView.NodeCheckbox` shows the check and toggles it under a pointer.
permissions.label: Permissions
permissions.title: Checkable

rename.about: With `canRename`, F2 opens `TreeView.NodeRenameInput` over the focused row. Enter keeps the new name, Escape cancels, and focus returns to the row. The caller replaces the node in its collection in `onRenameComplete`.
rename.label: Drafts
rename.title: Renaming

search.about: `filter` returns a collection of the matching nodes and their branches. While a query is typed, every branch of that collection is open.
search.label: Documents
search.title: Filtering

selected.about: The fill of a selected row. Subtle and solid fill it with the palette, and plain sets its text in medium weight.
selected.title: Selected looks

selection.about: In `multiple` mode Ctrl or Cmd with a press adds a row to the selection, Shift with a press or an arrow extends it, and Ctrl+A selects every row.
selection.title: Selection modes

size.about: Rows measure 24, 32 and 40px. The size also sets the text, the marks, the inset and the indent of each level.
size.title: Sizes

title: Tree view
